text:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx and latency in us-east-1 affecting Hosted API + Dedicated pools. Alerts from API-gateway and token-service. https://status.aws.amazon.com/ (auto-attached)
sre-jordan: ack — I'm on call. digging into logs and cross-regional metrics now.
eng-ml-maya: seeing a surge of upstream 503s from our authz proxy (third-party auth provider) around 17:05 UTC. KV cache misses increased as well.
eng-ml-maya: log sample:
```ERROR authz-client timeout=500ms status=503 host=authz.example.net path=/v1/validate token_id=***``` 
sre-jordan: confirmed 5xx spike across hostpool-us-east-1 and dedicated-us-east-1-*. p50 latency jumping from 40ms -> 900ms for token validation calls.
eng-platform-simon: starting regional routing fallback to prefer-us-west-2 for new sessions. Will start with canary 5%.
sre-jordan: runbook step 3 -> initiate routing override. command:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://control-plane.redwood.internal/api/v1/routing/override -d '{"region":"us-east-1","fallback":"us-west-2","percent":5}'
``` 
eng-platform-simon: applied canary. routing override id=ro-20261117-01 percent=5
eng-oncall-bot: metric-alert resolved: token-service-5xx-rate in us-east-1 down 10% since override
support-alejandra: top three customers seeing errors: Acmetech (high traffic), ParcelFlow (critical), EduLabs (moderate). I opened support tickets and flagged SLA risk.
pm-ryan: drafting status update for customers: "We are experiencing elevated errors in us-east-1 due to a third-party auth provider issue. We have routed traffic to an alternate region for new requests and are monitoring. No data loss. More updates in 30m." thumbs?
sre-jordan: thumbs. also note: for Dedicated pools we disabled regional sticky routing to let clients rehydrate to us-west-2. command executed:
```sql
UPDATE pool_config SET prefer_region='us-west-2' WHERE region='us-east-1' AND pool_type='dedicated';
``` 
eng-ml-maya: reduced model load by temporarily lowering max_seq_len for streaming sessions in the affected region to reduce KV pressure.
support-alejandra: Acmetech on call says partial degradation but fallback reduced errors by ~60% for them.
eng-platform-simon: ramping fallback from 5% -> 40% while we watch latency and cost. will only move more if 5xx rate stays elevated.
sre-jordan: coordinating with AWS status + auth provider. I've opened an escalated case with provider and shared traces.
eng-oncall-bot: new action: oncall-handoff planned at 18:00 UTC to @oncall-lee; please attach current runbook snippet.
sre-jordan: handing to @oncall-lee for continued mitigation and timeline. notes attached in thread. key items: routing override id=ro-20261117-01, customers impacted, watch token-service 5xx and kv-cache hitrate.
oncall-lee: taking over. thanks @sre-jordan. I'll keep routing at 40% for now, prepped to move to 80% if error rate holds. ping me for any escalations.
pm-ryan: draft posted to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating elevated errors in us-east-1. Traffic rerouted to alternative region. No customer data loss expected. Mitigation in place." will update in 30 minutes.
sre-jordan: initial mitigation working — overall 5xx rate in us-east-1 down from 9% -> 1.8% after 40% reroute. latency improving.
eng-ml-maya: still seeing occasional auth timeouts that correlate with AWS outbound NAT retries; keeping KV cache warm helps immediate sessions.
support-alejandra: preparing customer outreach for top 10 impacted customers; PRD and account teams looped.
oncall-lee: scheduling postmortem meeting for tomorrow 15:00 UTC. TODOs: follow up with auth provider incident ID, review routing policy defaults, verify dedicated pool failover automation.
eng-platform-simon: rollback plan ready if fallback causes regressions: revert override id=ro-20261117-01 -> percent=0.
eng-oncall-bot: incident severity downgraded to S2 at 18:40 UTC — impact reduced, some customers still affected intermittently.
sre-jordan: closing active pager for this phase. leaving the routing override in place at 40% until auth provider confirms fix. handing final notes to postmortem owners.
support-alejandra: ticket update: customers notified, most seeing improved performance. continuing to monitor.
pm-ryan: thanks team — please add any logs/commands to the incident doc for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) 18:60 UTC. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled, vendor escalation open.
